questions.q: What white markings did Black Beauty have?
choices: One white foot and a white star on his forehead
A white stripe down his back
questions.evidence: I had one white foot and a pretty white star on my forehead

questions.q: How old was Black Beauty when Squire Gordon came to look at him?
questions.evidence: When I was four years old Squire Gordon came to look at me

questions.q: In this chapter, what does "breaking in" a horse mean?
choices: Teaching a horse to wear a saddle and bridle and obey its rider
Breaking a horse's spirit with a whip
Letting a horse break out of its stable
questions.evidence: It means to teach a horse to wear a saddle and bridle

questions.q: Why did the master decide to break in Black Beauty himself?
choices: He did not want him to be frightened or hurt
questions.evidence: as he should not like me to be frightened or hurt

questions.q: How did Black Beauty feel about the bit when it was first put in his mouth?
choices: He thought it was a nasty, very bad thing
He liked the taste of the steel
He did not notice it at all
He thought it was fun to chew

questions.q: What helped Black Beauty get used to wearing the bit and bridle?
choices: Nice oats and his master's pats and kind words
Being left alone in the field
questions.evidence: what with the nice oats, and what with my master's pats, kind words, and gentle ways

questions.q: Which came after the bit and bridle in Black Beauty's training?
Which piece of harness did Black Beauty hate because it doubled up his tail?

choices: Side-pieces on the bridle that stopped him from seeing to the sides
Lights on the front of a carriage
Straps that went under his tail
questions.evidence: great side-pieces against my eyes called blinkers

questions.q: How did Black Beauty react the very first time a train went by?
choices: He galloped to the far side of the meadow, snorting with fear
He kept eating quietly like the cows
He ran up to the train to look at it
questions.evidence: I turned and galloped to the further side of the meadow

questions.q: Why did the master send Black Beauty to a farm next to the railway?
choices: So he would learn not to be afraid of trains
So he could eat better grass
So he could make friends with sheep
So the farmer could buy him
questions.evidence: I am as fearless at railway stations as in my own stable

questions.q: What did Black Beauty's mother say about foolish, careless men?
choices: They spoil more horses than all, just for want of sense
questions.evidence: these spoil more horses than all, just for want of sense
